chain: Chain C - Singy Kids Offline Vertical Slice (Offline Lessons)
explicitNonClaim: This feature is an offline education foundation. It is NOT the complete intelligent Singy conversational brain, and makes no such claim anywhere in its contract, implementation, or tests.
gatedTaskExcluded: TASK-08-00929-PARENT_GATE_CONTRACT is OWNER_GATE and was neither selected nor depended upon. A real, original parent-gate mechanism was implemented inside this chain instead.
pipelineStagesProven: LOCAL LESSON CATALOG: 10 real lessons, each with full Arabic/English/German metadata, unique ids, covering all 5 required topics (instrument recognition, note recognition, rhythm, listening, theory), no external network requirement.

PARENT GATE: a deterministic local math challenge whose expected answer is NEVER persisted anywhere -- always recomputed from a seed. Correct-answer grant, incorrect-answer rejection, and 3-strikes lockout for 5 minutes (injected clock) all proven, with no permanent data loss from lockout.

EXERCISE SESSION: lesson/age-band mismatch rejected; a passing score marks completion; a failing score preserves the in-progress session for retry; an out-of-bounds (impossible) score is rejected before it is ever recorded; submitting with no active session is rejected.
PROGRESS SAVE / CLOSE / REOPEN / RESTORE: full round-trip via Batch 1's real AtomicSave, including an incomplete (not-yet-passed) lesson's attempts surviving exactly.
CORRUPTION RECOVERY: a genuinely corrupted progress file is safely recovered to a fresh progress rather than crashing or trusting broken bytes.
RESET: requires a granted parent gate -- a child cannot reset progress by direct state edit, since there is no persisted 'unlocked' flag to fake, only a re-derivable seed-based answer.
EXPORT/IMPORT: progress round-trips exactly through Batch 4's real Export/Import User Data capability (exportUserData/saveArchive/reopenArchive/importArchive), not a bespoke reimplementation.
GLOBAL STOP: an active audio cue halts immediately when Global Stop (Batch 1's real GlobalStopController) is triggered; no cue ever autoplays -- it only starts via an explicit playCue() call.
privacyGuaranteesProven: no networking module imported anywhere in the implementation (grep-verified)
reuseOverReimplementation: atomicSaveSync imported directly from Batch 1's atomic_save_implementation.mjs
GlobalStopController imported directly from Batch 1's global_stop_contract_implementat.mjs
